timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: unknown

WHY: The article indicates the won/dollar exchange rate has risen for 7 consecutive trading days, meaning the won is weakening (KRW per USD is increasing). A weak won makes your USD conversion more expensive, so now is a relatively unfavorable time to convert your monthly KRW into $2,000.

TIP: Consider waiting for the won to strengthen (KRW/USD rate to fall) before making your conversion if possible, or establish a standing order to average your costs across multiple days rather than converting in one lump sum during a weak-won trend.
